## Summary

Describe the change and the reader need it addresses.

## Change type

- [ ] Add or update a guidance, standard, taxonomy, paper, model, dataset, benchmark, lab, tool, agent, or MCP server
- [ ] Correct a factual claim, citation, status, or canonical URL
- [ ] Mark a resource as archived, historical, experimental, or deprecated
- [ ] Improve documentation, governance, or safety guidance
- [ ] Other

## Curation checklist

- [ ] I read the [Curation Policy](../docs/CURATION_POLICY.md) and used the most specific appropriate category.
- [ ] I verified the canonical URL and checked for duplicates.
- [ ] The description is neutral, concise, and does not use unsupported marketing or performance language.
- [ ] I supplied or updated maintainer, license/terms, status, and review information where applicable.
- [ ] Any quantitative, compatibility, maintenance, or security-control claim has a relevant source and enough context to be interpreted.
- [ ] I marked any archived, historical, experimental, or uncertain resource clearly.
- [ ] I verified that all changed Markdown links and internal references render correctly.

## Safety checklist for tools, agents, models, datasets, labs, and MCP

- [ ] The change supports authorized security work, research, education, hardening, detection, remediation, or responsible disclosure.
- [ ] The change does not provide operational instructions for unauthorized access, defense evasion, malware, command-and-control, data theft, impersonation, or third-party targeting.
- [ ] For a tool, agent, or MCP server, I described the relevant permissions/effects, data exposure, isolation expectation, and approval boundary, or linked to its catalog metadata.
- [ ] For a model or dataset, I linked to relevant provenance, license/terms, intended-use, and evaluation information.

## Source and evidence

List the canonical source and any supporting evidence for material claims.
